lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: A standalone comedy episode: an old-school car flipper runs a school and loses an exam to a young student with a bot. Deadpan ironic narration. Last line — a confident, warm, clear advertising pitch for the bot «Перехват».

mihalych.profile: Mihalych — an old-school Russian used-car flipper in his 60s turned teacher, glasses, mustache, tie; gruff, strict, proud, a bit old-fashioned. Low husky voice.
mihalych.notes: Lines: 1 strict teacher dictating; 2 angry, scolding; 3 commanding, starts the exam; 4 on an old phone, hopeful then shocked; 5 deflated; 6 grudging respect, then a funny request.

vanya.profile: Vanya — a young, polite, cheerful Russian student in his 20s, a bit cheeky.
vanya.notes: Line 1: polite question, innocent. Line 2: calm, casual, slightly proud — already done.

galya.profile: Aunt Galya — a friendly Russian woman in her 50s selling her car, warm, talkative.
galya.notes: One line: cheerful, impressed, surprised how fast he called.
